polls.description: Multiple sources report US warnings about Chinese intelligence allegedly recruiting individuals with ties to Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang, raising national security concerns.
polls.question: Should US tech executives face stricter vetting of foreign contacts?

cluster_stories.title: US believes Nvidia’s Huang had romantic relationship with alleged Chinese spy
cluster_stories.summary: American intelligence warned the tech boss was involved with executive recruited by China to gather information on US group
cluster_stories.headline: US warns Nvidia's Huang had ties to alleged Chinese spy

cluster_stories.title: China’s top spy agency recruited woman who targeted Nvidia’s Jensen Huang
cluster_stories.summary: Alice Huang, a Chinese executive who developed a relationship with Nvidia's leader, is believed to be an asset of the Ministry of State Security.
cluster_stories.headline: China spy agency recruited woman targeting Nvidia CEO

cluster_stories.title: Spy targeting Nvidia CEO was alleged China intelligence service recruit: NYT
cluster_stories.summary: The Chinese businesswoman, with whom Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang had alleged ties, was recruited as a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security, The New York Times reported, citing a memo circulated among policymakers in the Trump administration.
cluster_stories.headline: Woman linked to Nvidia CEO recruited by China intelligence

polls.topic: AI Political Backlash and Policy Response
polls.description: Growing voter resistance to AI is shaping elections and forcing governments to respond, with the US midterms showing anti-AI sentiment while the UK commits to pushing forward despite backlash.
polls.question: Should governments slow AI development in response to voter concerns?

cluster_stories.title: Why does America hate AI?
cluster_stories.summary: Voter hostility to Big Tech helped shape the US midterms, and similar fears are spreading through the west. But look east and attitudes are dramatically more optimistic
cluster_stories.headline: US Voter Backlash Against AI Shapes Midterms

cluster_stories.title: UK will not slow down on AI despite backlash in US, says growth minister
cluster_stories.summary: Dan Tomlinson asserts that pace of investment is ‘too low for what we need to stay at the forefront as AI technology develops’
cluster_stories.headline: UK Vows to Push AI Despite US Backlash

cluster_stories.title: From the front row to the hot seat — what the midterms mean for Big Tech
cluster_stories.summary: After spending two years getting cozy with the White House, Big Tech is suddenly trying to make friends with Democrats, and the open question is whether that image makeover can hold up against what states, local communities, and the markets are about to do.
cluster_stories.headline: Big Tech Scrambles After Midterm Results
